en-US.author: owayo
en-US.longDescription:
astro-sight generates AST information for AI coding agents. Built on tree-sitter, it parses 16 languages
and returns AST fragments, symbol definitions, cross-file references, call graphs, imports, change impact,
dead code and co-change patterns as compact JSON or TOON. It also runs as an MCP server.
en-US.name: astro-sight
en-US.releaseNotes:
Install
Homebrew (macOS / Linux)
brew install owayo/astro-sight/astro-sight
winget (Windows)
winget install owayo.astro-sight
Open a new terminal afterwards so that the updated PATH takes effect.
Download
Download astro-sight-<target>.tar.gz for your platform from the assets below (.zip on Windows), extract it and put astro-sight on your PATH. SHA256SUMS lists the checksums of all assets.
x86_64-unknown-linux-musl is a statically linked build for Linux systems without glibc (Alpine) or with an old glibc.
curl -fLO https://github.com/owayo/astro-sight/releases/download/v26.11.104/astro-sight-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
tar -xzf astro-sight-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
